I’ll read the handoff and repository workflow, then carry out the seven-check assessment and save the findings, progress record, chat history, and continuation guidance.

The handoff sets a fixed analytical assessment with no theta numerics. I’ve confirmed this session is Sol at ultra effort. I’ll use parallel read-only checks for the moment bounds, flow argument, and controls, then reconcile them in one assessment. This remains an internal LLM review.

The checks so far support the stated constants and all-time energy floor. The key limit also holds: this coefficient proves \(H>0\), so it cannot handle a region crossing a simple zero, even when \((H,H_A)\) stays nonzero. I’m finishing the imported convergence checks and recording that scope explicitly.

All seven checks support acceptance without mathematical correction, including the zero-mass decay and uniform derivative convergence used by the later claims. I’m saving the assessment, supporting derivations, and exact-algebra record. The continuation will route the open joint-jet design question to B03 R3/Astra.

The assessment, notes, and continuation are saved. All nine frozen inputs and 29 exact-algebra checks pass, and the saved documents’ links resolve. Progress06 now marks E02 R2 complete and B03 R3 ready but unstarted. I’m refreshing chat0047 and arranging capture of this reply.

The contract fixes one ball, degrees 8/16/32, complete source tails, and two interval-arithmetic precisions. I’m checking the algebra and locating the installed Arb runtime before acquisition. This continues chat0047; the proof-author’s chat0046 remains separate.

The algebra checks pass, and the installed Arb runtime is available. The square checks also reproduced the historical zero-centered interval issue; the script now handles those cases with explicit nonnegative bounds. I’m checking the implementation against the packet before starting acquisition.

Degree 8 is rigorously positive at both 256 and 384 bits, so acquisition stopped there as prescribed. It gives a regional jet floor above \(1.01\times10^{-6}\) and an all-time energy floor above \(8.6\times10^{-41}\). The independent allowance also passes on this ball. I’m saving the evidence and preparing the bounded E02 R3 assessment request.

A source-free replay of the saved intervals confirms the coefficient, jet floor, and energy bound. The same inputs also give a valid C01 comparison coefficient \(C=4\). I’m recording that this is a certificate for the frozen ball; it does not establish that the ball contains a theta simple zero or give broader coverage.

The evidence, execution notes, self-check, and model handoff are saved. Progress06 marks E01 R1 complete and E02 R3 ready; the 15 assessment-input hashes and document links pass verification. I’m refreshing chat0047 and arranging capture of the final reply.

I’ll read the adaptive-radius handoff and frozen E01 R2 contract, refresh this chat’s history, and carry out the fixed calculation. I’ll leave the manuscript untouched while Astra works on it.

The proof and amendment checks pass. The comparison requires all twelve radius/degree cases under all three rules, so it will run through the full table. I’ll use the prescribed real panels for the absolute-value integrals, retain the phase-boundary and tail payments, and record the downward rounding convention for the formula-derived ball.

The implementation is ready for review: it shares the center jets, encloses each absolute-value core with real panels, and records the conservative omitted-mode payments explicitly. The fixed comparison and formula-derived ball are kept separate. The manuscript remains excluded from all writes.

The full table is decided at both precisions; 1024 panels sufficed without refinement. At radius \(1/256\), separating the radii lowers the first passing degree from none through 8 to degree 8, and the IBP rule lowers it further to degree 4. At \(1/128\), both separate-radius rules first pass at degree 8. I’m checking the saved arithmetic and matched-consumer results before writing the return.

The saved-data checks confirm the results. The prescribed representative is radius \(1/128\), degree 8: its joint test passes, while both simple scalar-floor tests fail. That does not establish an advantage over an optimal direct consumer. The amended formula gives a downward-rounded degree-one radius of \(1/8192\). I’m saving the evidence and preparing the bounded assessment handoff; no manuscript files have been edited.

The execution return, evidence, self-check, and E02 R5 handoff are saved. All 20 assessment-input hashes and document links pass verification, and the original acquisition record is preserved unchanged. Astra’s integration entry is intact; no manuscript files or navigation indexes were edited. I’m refreshing chat0047 and arranging final-reply capture.

Completed **FCG-E01 R2**. I did not modify the manuscript.

All 36 margins were resolved at both precisions. At radius \(1/256\), the IBP bounds reduce the smallest passing issued degree from 8 to 4. The adaptive formula also certifies a degree-one radius of \(1/8192\).

Saved the [research notes](/Users/ebbaker/Documents/shifted-zeta-positivity/papers/investigations-5/05_radial_theta_collision_geometry/notes/fixed_coefficient_parameter_geometry/E01_R2_ADAPTIVE_RADIUS_IBP_EXECUTION_20261030.md), numerical evidence, and self-check; updated the progress register and refreshed chat history.
